text: The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top speed of 540 km/h during testing on the North Quay test line on Tuesday, according to local transport officials. The run, conducted before dawn in dry conditions, was the fastest recorded by the experimental train since trials began last year. The prototype completed the 18-kilometre circuit in just under two minutes, surpassing its previous mark of 510 km/h. Harbour Transit Authority chair Leena Morin said the result showed the system was ready for expanded safety checks and passenger-focused trials. Engineers said the train remained stable throughout the high-speed pass, and braking performance matched expectations. Further tests are scheduled for later this month.
